widgets_values: Move the camera to a back-facing position so the full body of the character is visible. The character stands with both arms extended slightly downward and close to the thighs, keeping the body evenly balanced on both sides. Background is plain white.

You can test and find the best setting by yourself. The following table is for reference.

| Model            | Steps | CFG |
|---------------------|---------------|---------------|
| Offical             | 50               | 4.0               
| fp8_e4m3fn             | 20                | 2.5               |
| fp8_e4m3fn + 4steps LoRA    | 4               | 1.0               |
